DA_GM_calc_ward_wall = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut which = DA_GM_seats_abjuration }
	change_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = -1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_bl_1 which = DA_GM_cut }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_bl_1 value = -5 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_GM_bl_1 value = 15 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_bl_1 value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_bl_1 value = 0 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 0.1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 0.5 } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 0.5 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 1 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 which = DA_GM_cut }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 9 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.ward_wall } } multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 1.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_done.grand_circle } multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 0.85 } }
	round_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_m_1 value = 1 } }
}

		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.red_stone } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.masque_of_crowns } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.oathbound_realm } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.living_bulwark } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.clay_legion } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.false_sun } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.council_of_shades } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.unending_host } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.starbridge } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.grand_circle } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_known.weave_unbound } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_known_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering check_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct which = DA_GM_c1_total }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct which = DA_GM_c1_left }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 12 }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct which = DA_GM_c1_total }
			round_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = -1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_ready }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 24 }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct which = DA_GM_c1_held }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 12 }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 24 }
			round_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_gathering check_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_total value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct which = DA_GM_c2_total }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct which = DA_GM_c2_left }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = 12 }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct which = DA_GM_c2_total }
			round_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = -1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_ready }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = 24 }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct which = DA_GM_c2_held }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = 12 }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = 24 }
			round_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = 1 }
		}
	}
}
# ---------------------------------------- convene, release, finish (one of each per rite)
# The Ward-Wall
DA_GM_convene_ward_wall = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_cv_ward_wall_tt
	add_treasury = -500
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_GM_count_seats = yes
		DA_GM_calc_ward_wall = yes
		change_mana = { amount = -75 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -15 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -10 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_active.ward_wall
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last_m which = DA_GM_m_1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_rite value = 1 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left which = DA_GM_m_1 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total which = DA_GM_m_1 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 0 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy set_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering set_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 1 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_left which = DA_GM_m_1 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_total which = DA_GM_m_1 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_held value = 0 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_busy set_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_gathering set_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.ward_wall }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_grand_rite } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_grand_rite duration = -1 } }
		DA_GM_refresh = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_GM.2 }
	}
}
DA_GM_release_ward_wall = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_rl_75_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		change_mana = { amount = -75 }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_wall
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.ward_wall
		DA_GM_after_change = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_GM.101 }
	}
}
DA_GM_finish_ward_wall = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_after_10_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_known.ward_wall
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_1 value = 10 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.ward_wall } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_left value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_total value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_held value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_pct value = 0 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_busy clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_gathering clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_ready }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.ward_wall } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_rite value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 0 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_ready }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_active.ward_wall
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_wall
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.ward_wall
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.ward_wall
		DA_GM_after_change = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_GM.9 }
	}
}
DA_GM_effect_ward_wall = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_fx_ward_wall_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { any_neighbor_province = { owner = { NOT = { tag = ROOT } } } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_GM_ward_wall duration = 9125 }
		}
	}
}

	hidden_effect = {
		event_target:DA_GM_target_country = {
			if = { limit = { DA_GM_warded_realm = yes } add_country_modifier = { name = block_magic_temp_modifier duration = 912 } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_severed duration = 4562 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_GM_warded_realm = yes } } add_country_modifier = { name = block_magic_temp_modifier duration = 1825 } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_severed duration = 9125 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GM_tmp value = 0 }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_tmp which = currentMana }
			change_mana = { var_amount = DA_GM_tmp }
			update_mana_regen_vars = yes
			if = { limit = { has_estate = estate_mages } add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_mages loyalty = -20 } }
		}
	}
}

	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_stain_victim_tt
	hidden_effect = { event_target:DA_GM_target_country = { add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_GM_victim_severance } add_casus_belli = { target = ROOT type = cb_DA_GM_avenge months = 300 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_victim_rite value = 3 } country_event = { id = DA_GM.62 } } }
	increase_estate_witch_king_points = { size = large }
	if = { limit = { exists = A85 NOT = { tag = A85 } } custom_tooltip = DA_GM_stain_magisterium_tt hidden_effect = { A85 = { add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_GM_magisterium } } } }
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = DA_GM.61 days = 3 } }
}

		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_grand_rite } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_grand_rite duration = -1 } }
		DA_GM_refresh = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_GM.2 }
	}

			add_stability = -3

				limit = { is_colony = no NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_GM_pick } }

	if = { limit = { exists = A85 NOT = { tag = A85 } } custom_tooltip = DA_GM_stain_magisterium_tt hidden_effect = { A85 = { add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_GM_magisterium } } } }
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = DA_GM.61 days = 3 } }
}
# The Verdant Change
DA_GM_convene_verdant_change = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_cv_verdant_change_tt
	add_treasury = -500
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_GM_count_seats = yes
		DA_GM_calc_verdant_change = yes
		change_mana = { amount = -75 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -15 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -10 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_active.verdant_change
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last value = 22 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last_m which = DA_GM_m_22 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_rite value = 22 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left which = DA_GM_m_22 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total which = DA_GM_m_22 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 0 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy set_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering set_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 22 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_left which = DA_GM_m_22 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_total which = DA_GM_m_22 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_held value = 0 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_busy set_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_gathering set_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.verdant_change }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_grand_rite } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_grand_rite duration = -1 } }
		DA_GM_refresh = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_GM.2 }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.verdant_change } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_rite value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 0 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_ready }

DA_GM_effect_red_stone = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_fx_stone_province_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		event_target:DA_GM_target_prov = {
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = trigger_value:development }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 2 }
			round_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = -1 }
			while = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 1 } development = 4 }
				if = { limit = { base_tax = 2 } add_base_tax = -1 change_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = -1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 1 } base_production = 2 } add_base_production = -1 change_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = -1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 1 } base_manpower = 2 } add_base_manpower = -1 change_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = -1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { base_tax = 2 } NOT = { base_production = 2 } NOT = { base_manpower = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cut value = 0 } }
			}
			add_devastation = 100
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone } custom_tooltip = DA_GM_fx_stone_grows_tt hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_3 NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_4 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_4 duration = -1 } } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_2 NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_3 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_3 duration = -1 } } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_1 NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_2 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_2 duration = -1 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_1 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_red_stone_grown_1 duration = -1 } } } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_red_stone } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_red_stone duration = -1 } }
}

# The Living Bulwark
DA_GM_convene_living_bulwark = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_cv_living_bulwark_tt
	add_treasury = -1500
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_GM_count_seats = yes
		DA_GM_calc_living_bulwark = yes
		change_mana = { amount = -150 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -30 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -10 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_active.living_bulwark
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last value = 27 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last_m which = DA_GM_m_27 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_rite value = 27 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left which = DA_GM_m_27 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total which = DA_GM_m_27 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 0 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy set_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering set_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 27 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_left which = DA_GM_m_27 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_total which = DA_GM_m_27 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_held value = 0 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_busy set_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_gathering set_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.living_bulwark }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_assigned
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_grand_rite } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_grand_rite duration = -1 } }
		DA_GM_refresh = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_GM.2 }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.living_bulwark } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_rite value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_total value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_pct value = 0 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering clr_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_ready }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_active.living_bulwark
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.living_bulwark

DA_GM_effect_council_of_shades = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GM_fx_shades_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		define_advisor = { type = philosopher skill = 3 cost_multiplier = 0.25 }
		define_advisor = { type = statesman skill = 3 cost_multiplier = 0.25 }
		define_advisor = { type = army_reformer skill = 3 cost_multiplier = 0.25 }
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_GM_sa value = trigger_value:adm }
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_GM_sd value = trigger_value:dip }
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_GM_sm value = trigger_value:mil }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_sd which = DA_GM_sa } check_variable = { which = DA_GM_sm which = DA_GM_sa } NOT = { adm = 6 } } change_adm = 1 set_country_flag = DA_GM_tmp }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_tmp } check_variable = { which = DA_GM_sm which = DA_GM_sd } NOT = { dip = 6 } } change_dip = 1 set_country_flag = DA_GM_tmp }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_tmp } NOT = { mil = 6 } } change_mil = 1 }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_tmp
	}
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_council_of_shades duration = 7300 }
	increase_estate_witch_king_points = { size = medium }
}

		DA_GM_calc_starbridge = yes
		change_mana = { amount = -150 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -20 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -20 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GM_active.starbridge
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last value = 32 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_last_m which = DA_GM_m_32 }

		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 31 } } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 15 } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_active.unending_host clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.unending_host clr_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.unending_host }
		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 32 } } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_active.starbridge clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.starbridge clr_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.starbridge }
		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 33 } } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grand_circle clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grand_circle clr_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.grand_circle }
		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_c2_rite value = 34 } } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 15 } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 15 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 15 } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_active.weave_unbound clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.weave_unbound clr_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.weave_unbound }
		DA_GM_clear_2 = yes
		DA_GM_after_change = yes
	}
}
DA_GM_tick = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_ready } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 1 } if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_held value = 24 } } DA_GM_fade_1 = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_ready } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_held value = 1 } if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_held value = 24 } } DA_GM_fade_2 = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_gathering } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left value = -1 } if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_c1_left value = 1 } } } DA_GM_ready_1 = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_gathering } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_left value = -1 } if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_c2_left value = 1 } } } DA_GM_ready_2 = yes } }
	DA_GM_after_change = yes
}
DA_GM_after_change = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c1_busy } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_c2_busy } } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on remove_country_modifier = DA_GM_grand_rite }
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.ward_of_ages
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severance
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.conjured_city
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.host_below
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severed_thread
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.crown_of_strings
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.skyfall
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.rain_of_ruin
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.waking_nightmare
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.black_harvest
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.philosophers_mountain
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.red_stone
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_of_ages NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.ward_of_ages } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.ward_of_ages set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.severance NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.severance } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severance set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.conjured_city NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.conjured_city } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.conjured_city set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.host_below NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.host_below } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.host_below set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.severed_thread NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.severed_thread } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severed_thread set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.crown_of_strings NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.crown_of_strings } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.crown_of_strings set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.skyfall NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.skyfall } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.skyfall set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.rain_of_ruin NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.rain_of_ruin } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.rain_of_ruin set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.waking_nightmare NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.waking_nightmare } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.waking_nightmare set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.black_harvest NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.black_harvest } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.black_harvest set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.philosophers_mountain NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.philosophers_mountain } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.philosophers_mountain set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.red_stone NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.red_stone } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.red_stone set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_of_ages has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.ward_of_ages } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.ward_of_ages set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.severance has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.severance } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severance set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.conjured_city has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.conjured_city } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.conjured_city set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.host_below has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.host_below } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.host_below set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.severed_thread has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.severed_thread } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severed_thread set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.crown_of_strings has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.crown_of_strings } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.crown_of_strings set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.skyfall has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.skyfall } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.skyfall set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.rain_of_ruin has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.rain_of_ruin } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.rain_of_ruin set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.waking_nightmare has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.waking_nightmare } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.waking_nightmare set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.black_harvest has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.black_harvest } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.black_harvest set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.philosophers_mountain has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.philosophers_mountain } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.philosophers_mountain set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.red_stone has_country_flag = DA_GM_in_c2.red_stone } set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.red_stone set_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } set_country_flag = DA_GM_holding_target }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set } } clr_country_flag = DA_GM_holding_target }
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_aim_set
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.crown_of_strings } DA_GM_crown_scan = yes }
	DA_GM_refresh = yes
}
# The Crown of Strings: which neighbours have at most half our development (a flag on them, renewed each month while the rite waits)
DA_GM_crown_scan = {
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_GM_half_dev value = trigger_value:total_development }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_half_dev value = 2 }
	every_neighbor_country = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_GM_crownable
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_GM_dev value = trigger_value:total_development }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GM_half_dev which = ROOT }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_half_dev which = DA_GM_dev } } set_country_flag = DA_GM_crownable }
	}
}
DA_GM_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on } DA_GM_tick = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Grand_Magic NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_circle_on } } DA_GM_refresh = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------- the rites' own helpers
# Country scope X; event_target:DA_GM_kill_prov the province; ROOT the caster with DA_GM_cap regiments left to destroy.
# Half of X's regiments in the province, rounded up, at most the cap, are destroyed.
DA_GM_halve_units = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 0 }
	event_target:DA_GM_kill_prov = {
		if = { limit = { num_of_units_in_province = { who = PREV amount = 1 } } PREV = { set_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { num_of_units_in_province = { who = PREV amount = 2 } } PREV = { set_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { num_of_units_in_province = { who = PREV amount = 3 } } PREV = { set_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 3 } } }

	}
	divide_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 2 }
	round_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cap which = ROOT }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_n which = DA_GM_cap } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_n which = DA_GM_cap } }
	ROOT = { set_variable = { which = DA_GM_n which = PREV } subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_cap which = DA_GM_n } }
	event_target:DA_GM_kill_prov = {
		while = {
			limit = { PREV = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = 1 } } num_of_units_in_province = { who = PREV amount = 1 } }
			clr_province_flag = DA_GM_k
			if = { limit = { infantry_in_province = PREV } kill_units = { who = PREV type = infantry amount = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GM_k }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_GM_k } cavalry_in_province = PREV } kill_units = { who = PREV type = cavalry amount = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GM_k }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_GM_k } artillery_in_province = PREV } kill_units = { who = PREV type = artillery amount = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GM_k }
			clr_province_flag = DA_GM_k
			PREV = { change_variable = { which = DA_GM_n value = -1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Province scope. The Host Below: an Abyssal Rift opens here.
DA_GM_open_rift = {
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_GM_abyssal_rift duration = 3650 }
	set_province_flag = DA_GM_rift
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_rift_y value = 0 }
	set_global_flag = DA_GM_rifts_exist
	add_devastation = 10
	every_neighbor_province = { add_devastation = 5 }
}
# Province scope, once a year by its owner: demons, devastation; an Abjuration tower near it closes it twice as fast.
DA_GM_rift_year = {
	change_variable = { which = DA_GM_rift_y value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { DA_GM_abjuration_tower = yes any_neighbor_province = { DA_GM_abjuration_tower = yes } } } change_variable = { which = DA_GM_rift_y value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_rift_y value = 10 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_GM_abyssal_rift }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_GM_abyssal_rift } add_devastation = 10 every_neighbor_province = { add_devastation = 5 } spawn_rebels = { type = demons_rebels_spell size = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_GM_abyssal_rift } } clr_province_flag = DA_GM_rift }
}
# Province scope. The Black Harvest: the curse breaks out here (the illness model's own infection) and the province is harvested.
DA_GM_harvest_province = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } } DA_ILL_infect_18 = yes }
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_GM_harvested duration = 3650 }
}
# The caster, once a year: mana for every five sick provinces of its victims (the victim opinion links them).
DA_GM_harvest_count = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 0 }
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GM_harvest_victim has_opinion_modifier = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_GM_victim_black_harvest } } every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } ROOT = { change_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 1 } } } }
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GM_harvest_1
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GM_harvest_2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GM_harvest_3
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GM_harvest_4
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 20 }  } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_harvest_4 duration = 365 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 15 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 20 } } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_harvest_3 duration = 365 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 10 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 15 } } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_harvest_2 duration = 365 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_harvest_n value = 10 } } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GM_harvest_1 duration = 365 } }
}
# The victim, once a year: the curse returns where it was cured or burnt; the dead rise twice as often (a second roll).
DA_GM_harvest_victim_year = {
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_GM_harvested }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } } DA_ILL_infect_18 = yes set_province_flag = DA_GM_reinfected }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_GM_reinfected } } random = { chance = 20 DA_ILL_dead_rise = yes } }
		clr_province_flag = DA_GM_reinfected
	}
}
# The Weave Unbound keeps Anbennar's three-quarter spells of every school; the towers (DA_MT_3q flags) leave them alone.
DA_GM_weave_keep = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = abjuration_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = abjuration_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.abjuration
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = conjuration_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = conjuration_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.conjuration
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = divination_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = divination_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.divination
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = enchantment_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = enchantment_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.enchantment
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = evocation_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = evocation_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.evocation
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = illusion_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = illusion_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.illusion
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = necromancy_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = necromancy_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.necromancy
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = transmutation_spell_three_quarter } } add_country_modifier = { name = transmutation_spell_three_quarter duration = -1 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_3q.transmutation
}

	change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -20 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -20 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -20 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 400 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_tmp value = 0 } subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_tmp which = currentMana } change_mana = { var_amount = DA_GM_tmp } set_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_paid }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_paid } } change_mana = { amount = -400 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_paid
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_paid } } change_mana = { amount = -300 } }
	clr_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_paid
}
DA_GM_ai_pay_waking_nightmare = {
	add_treasury = -1500
	change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -30 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -20 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 300 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_GM_tmp value = 0 } subtract_variable = { which = DA_GM_tmp which = currentMana } change_mana = { var_amount = DA_GM_tmp } set_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_paid }

}

# Witch-Kings at AI strength Hard and Very hard may turn a forbidden rite on a rival.
DA_GM_ai_forbidden = {
	if = {
		limit = { ruler_is_witch_king = yes OR = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_hard has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_very_hard } any_rival_country = { always = yes } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_chose } DA_GM_ai_can_severance = yes } random_rival_country = { save_event_target_as = DA_GM_target_country } DA_GM_ai_pay_severance = yes DA_GM_effect_severance = yes DA_GM_stain_severance = yes set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_3 value = 30 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_chose }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_chose } DA_GM_ai_can_waking_nightmare = yes } random_rival_country = { save_event_target_as = DA_GM_target_country } DA_GM_ai_pay_waking_nightmare = yes DA_GM_effect_waking_nightmare = yes DA_GM_stain_waking_nightmare = yes set_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_18 value = 30 } set_country_flag = DA_GM_ai_chose }
	}
}
